scientific_integrity: All two inverse-temperature limits follow analytically from the exact scalar recurrence and uniform quadrature comparison. Finite tests are supplementary; independent expert audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two normalized tokens with symmetric isotropic query and key, identity value matrix, constant eta>0, and beta tending to infinity. The boundary-layer limit is pointwise for fixed z>0. No claim for many tokens, anisotropy, time-varying weights, or transformer layernorm.
title: An exponential-integral metastability law for two-token normalized self-attention
